Generate Q Matrix

Source: R/sim_diags.R
Q_mat.Rd

Generates the Q matrix for the epidemic model. CD4-only latent states definition: Latent state 1: CD4 > 500 Latent state 2: 500 < CD4 < 350 Latent state 3: 200 < CD4 < 350 Latent state 4: CD4 < 200

Usage

Q_mat(t, d_probs, q_age, nlatst, nage = 52, rita = FALSE)

Arguments

t

Time index.

d_probs

Diagnosis probabilities.

q_age

Age-specific progression probabilities.

nlatst

Number of latent states.

nage

Number of age groups.

rita

Logical indicating whether RITA-specific logic should be applied.

Value

Q matrix.

Details

RITA latent states definition: Latent state 1: CD4 > 500, HIV acquired in the last three months Latent state 2: CD4 > 500, HIV acquired between 3 and 6 months ago Latent state 3: 500 < CD4 < 350, HIV acquired between 3 and 6 months ago Latent state 4: CD4 > 500, HIV acquired more than 6 months ago Latent state 5: 500 < CD4 < 350, HIV acquired more than 6 months ago Latent state 6: 350 < CD4 < 200, HIV acquired more than 6 months ago Latent state 7: CD4 < 200, HIV acquired more than 6 months ago

Examples

q_age <- matrix(rep(c(0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5), 52), nrow = 52, byrow = TRUE)
d_probs <- matrix(rep(0.1, 40), nrow = 10)
Q_mat(t = 10, d_probs, q_age, nlatst = 4, nage = 52, rita = FALSE)
